verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that a sandbox is an isolated cloud computer where the agent can run code and install software. They also document an SSH shell and stateful REPL and stateless Cmd process contexts for running commands. Docker-in-sandbox, custom images and an auto-growing RootFS support package installs, and the probe confirmed the docs page is live. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of command execution and package installation.
